#!/usr/bin/env bash
# exp-008v3 (Binary Probe GRPO) unified eval script
# LoRA checkpoints — no DeepSpeed merge needed

set -euo pipefail

PYTHON="/root/miniconda3/bin/python"
EVAL_SCRIPT="/root/contrastive_entrain_calib/eval/eval_unified_preset.py"
BASE_MODEL="/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/Qwen/Qwen3-8B"
CKPT_DIR="/root/contrastive_entrain_calib/checkpoints/exp008v3_binary_probe_grpo"
OUTPUT_DIR="/root/contrastive_entrain_calib/results/exp008v3_unified_eval"

export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1
export TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1

# GPU via CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES (pass from outside, e.g. CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0)
echo "=== exp-008v3 unified eval ==="
echo "GPU: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=${CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES:-not set}"
echo "Base model: ${BASE_MODEL}"
echo "Checkpoint dir: ${CKPT_DIR}"
echo "Output dir: ${OUTPUT_DIR}"

mkdir -p "${OUTPUT_DIR}"

# All possible checkpoints (save_steps=500, max_steps=8000)
STEPS=(500 1000 1500 2000 2500 3000 3500 4000 4500 5000 5500 6000 6500 7000 7500 8000)

for STEP in "${STEPS[@]}"; do
    LORA_PATH="${CKPT_DIR}/checkpoint-${STEP}"
    EXP_ID="exp008v3-ckpt${STEP}"

    if [ ! -f "${LORA_PATH}/adapter_model.safetensors" ]; then
        echo "[SKIP] checkpoint-${STEP} not found"
        continue
    fi

    if [ -f "${OUTPUT_DIR}/${EXP_ID}_results.json" ]; then
        echo "[SKIP] ${EXP_ID} already evaluated"
        continue
    fi

    echo ""
    echo "=========================================="
    echo "[EVAL] ${EXP_ID}"
    echo "  LoRA: ${LORA_PATH}"
    echo "=========================================="

    ${PYTHON} "${EVAL_SCRIPT}" \
        --model_path "${BASE_MODEL}" \
        --lora_path "${LORA_PATH}" \
        --output_dir "${OUTPUT_DIR}" \
        --exp_id "${EXP_ID}" \
        --max_new_tokens 512

    echo "[DONE] ${EXP_ID}"
done

# Final checkpoint (saved at end of training)
FINAL_PATH="${CKPT_DIR}/final"
FINAL_EXP_ID="exp008v3-final"

if [ -f "${FINAL_PATH}/adapter_model.safetensors" ]; then
    if [ ! -f "${OUTPUT_DIR}/${FINAL_EXP_ID}_results.json" ]; then
        echo ""
        echo "=========================================="
        echo "[EVAL] ${FINAL_EXP_ID}"
        echo "  LoRA: ${FINAL_PATH}"
        echo "=========================================="

        ${PYTHON} "${EVAL_SCRIPT}" \
            --model_path "${BASE_MODEL}" \
            --lora_path "${FINAL_PATH}" \
            --output_dir "${OUTPUT_DIR}" \
            --exp_id "${FINAL_EXP_ID}" \
            --max_new_tokens 512

        echo "[DONE] ${FINAL_EXP_ID}"
    else
        echo "[SKIP] ${FINAL_EXP_ID} already evaluated"
    fi
else
    echo "[SKIP] final checkpoint not found"
fi

echo ""
echo "=== exp-008v3 eval complete ==="
echo "Results: ${OUTPUT_DIR}/"
ls -la "${OUTPUT_DIR}/"
SCRIPT_EOF
chmod +x /root/contrastive_entrain_calib/eval/run_exp008v3_unified_eval.sh
echo "Script created."
